objective: Open the Minecraft module with a real pinned Mineflayer adapter that can connect only to an owner-selected local or private resettable server, exposes a bounded repository-owned world and inventory snapshot, and stops local bot control immediately through a latched emergency stop.
non_goals: Do not connect to a public server, an important owner world or a production realm.
Do not add pathfinding, movement, collection, crafting, combat, chat, sign, book or destructive actions in this slice.
Do not connect the LLM, execute model-generated JavaScript, use eval, launch a shell or accept arbitrary plugin code.
Do not expose Mineflayer or Prismarine vendor types outside the adapter implementation.
Do not expose a mutating network control endpoint, bind a status listener outside loopback or enable a debug viewer.
Do not claim real-server compatibility or emergency-stop network acknowledgement until the owner runs the local server smoke.
Do not resume M08 implementation; the owner deferred the real 20-image Cloud Vision quality evidence without converting it into a measured pass.
contracts: Runtime connection targets are restricted to localhost, IPv4 loopback, RFC1918 IPv4, IPv6 loopback, link-local IPv6 or unique-local IPv6; public IPs and arbitrary DNS names fail closed.
The initial runtime supports offline authentication only and validates the Minecraft username, port, optional protocol version and status-port bounds before calling Mineflayer.
Mineflayer and Prismarine objects stay private to the adapter; public status contains only bounded repository-owned plain data.
The status service is read-only, binds exactly to 127.0.0.1 and exposes only fixed health and status GET routes.
Emergency stop is idempotent and latched for the process lifetime; it clears local control states, requests digging cancellation and disconnects without waiting for server acknowledgement.
Chat, book, sign, scoreboard and plugin payloads are not collected, logged or surfaced in the normalized snapshot.
No model, LLM planner, generated code, eval, shell, arbitrary action or destructive capability is reachable in this slice.
allowed_dependencies: mineflayer 4.37.1 pinned from the official PrismarineJS package.
TypeScript 6.0.3 and @types/node 26.1.1 already pinned in the workspace.
acceptance_criteria: The package builds a real Mineflayer-backed CLI and does not contain a fake runtime implementation.
Unit tests prove private-target validation, public-target rejection, bounded snapshot normalization, vendor-type isolation, connection error handling and idempotent latched emergency stop.
A read-only loopback status server returns bounded health/status JSON and rejects all mutation methods and unknown routes.
Root scripts expose start:minecraft and test:minecraft, and the repository fast test includes the Minecraft unit gate.
Mineflayer package version, npm integrity, upstream revision, license and no-copy integration are recorded in the lock/provenance files.
Module-brief validation, adapter test/build, repository fast tests, GitNexus change scan and git diff check pass.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M09-S1-mineflayer-connection-spine-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"
